title: Normalize trap hazard taxonomy for deterministic filtering
description:
Problem:
Hazard taxonomy is inconsistent. Poisons and diseases expose category, but traps currently expose trapType only. This makes deterministic filtering and DM model retrieval less uniform.

Observed shape:
- poisons: category-like information is present.
- diseases: category-like information is present.
- traps: trapType is present, but category:'trap' is absent.

Implement:
- Normalize trap records so they expose a category or equivalent discriminator that identifies them as traps.
- Preserve trapType for mechanical vs magical trap distinctions.
- Update schema, importer output, and tests.
- Confirm hazard count/reporting still matches final pack records.

Acceptance criteria:
- Traps can be queried by hazard category without special-casing trapType.
- Existing poison and disease records remain compatible.
- Tests cover trap filtering.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Completed together in PR: traps now expose category trap with schema/tests/generated pack updates; verifier/importer summaries report final record-kind and hazard-category counts; rogue fixed equipment sourceText normalized; audit bundle emits gameplay-readiness report.
